1	"""Incident status state machine and immutable transition history.
2	
3	An incident moves ``open -> acknowledged -> resolved`` only. Every accepted
4	transition updates the incident row and appends one immutable history record
5	inside a single locked write transaction, so the new status and its history
6	entry are committed together or not at all, and concurrent transitions cannot
7	both observe the same prior status. Rejected transitions write nothing.
8	"""
9	
10	import uuid
11	from typing import Any
12	
13	from sqlalchemy import Connection, Engine, select

16	from .chain import _run_with_lock_retry, _utc_now_iso
17	from .db import (
18	    AuthorizationDecisionEvent,

20	    IncidentStatusEvent,
21	    Machine,
22	)

24	_INCIDENT_TABLE = AuthorizationDecisionIncident.__table__
25	_HISTORY_TABLE = IncidentStatusEvent.__table__
26	
27	# The only legal edges of the incident state machine.
28	_ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS = {
29	    "open": "acknowledged",
30	    "acknowledged": "resolved",
31	}

34	def get_machine_event_incident(
35	    session: Session, machine_id: str, event_id: str, incident_id: str
36	) -> AuthorizationDecisionIncident | None:
37	    """Resolve an incident that belongs to the path machine and event.
38	
39	    Returns ``None`` when the machine, event, or incident is missing or when
40	    any of them belongs to a different owner than the path claims.
41	    """
42	    machine = session.get(Machine, machine_id)
43	    if machine is None:
44	        return None
45	    event = session.scalar(
46	        select(AuthorizationDecisionEvent).where(
47	            AuthorizationDecisionEvent.id == event_id,
48	            AuthorizationDecisionEvent.machine_id == machine_id,
49	        )
50	    )
51	    if event is None:
52	        return None
53	    return session.scalar(
54	        select(AuthorizationDecisionIncident).where(
55	            AuthorizationDecisionIncident.id == incident_id,
56	            AuthorizationDecisionIncident.machine_id == machine_id,
57	            AuthorizationDecisionIncident.event_id == event_id,
58	        )
59	    )

62	def change_incident_status(
63	    engine: Engine,
64	    *,
65	    machine_id: str,
66	    event_id: str,
67	    incident_id: str,
68	    to_status: str,
69	) -> dict[str, Any]:
70	    """Atomically advance one incident's status and append its history record.
71	
72	    All lookups and the write happen in one locked transaction. Returns a
73	    status dict:
74	
75	    * ``not_found`` — the machine, event, or incident is missing or owned by
76	      another machine/event;
77	    * ``invalid_status_transition`` — the incident's current status has no edge
78	      to ``to_status`` (nothing is written);
79	    * ``ok`` — with the updated ``incident`` and the new ``history`` record.
80	    """
81	
82	    def _work(conn: Connection) -> dict[str, Any]:
83	        machine = conn.execute(
84	            Machine.__table__.select().where(Machine.__table__.c.id == machine_id)
85	        ).first()
86	        if machine is None:
87	            return {"status": "not_found"}
88	        event = conn.execute(
89	            AuthorizationDecisionEvent.__table__.select().where(
90	                AuthorizationDecisionEvent.__table__.c.id == event_id,
91	                AuthorizationDecisionEvent.__table__.c.machine_id == machine_id,
92	            )
93	        ).first()
94	        if event is None:
95	            return {"status": "not_found"}
96	        incident_row = conn.execute(
97	            _INCIDENT_TABLE.select().where(
98	                _INCIDENT_TABLE.c.id == incident_id,
99	                _INCIDENT_TABLE.c.machine_id == machine_id,
100	                _INCIDENT_TABLE.c.event_id == event_id,
101	            )
102	        ).first()
103	        if incident_row is None:
104	            return {"status": "not_found"}
105	
106	        incident = incident_row._mapping
107	        from_status = incident["status"]
108	        if _ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS.get(from_status) != to_status:
109	            return {"status": "invalid_status_transition"}
110	
111	        now = _utc_now_iso()
112	        history_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
113	        conn.execute(
114	            _INCIDENT_TABLE.update()
115	            .where(_INCIDENT_TABLE.c.id == incident_id)
116	            .values(status=to_status)
117	        )
118	        conn.execute(
119	            _HISTORY_TABLE.insert().values(
120	                id=history_id,
121	                machine_id=machine_id,
122	                event_id=event_id,
123	                incident_id=incident_id,
124	                from_status=from_status,
125	                to_status=to_status,
126	                created_at=now,
127	            )
128	        )
129	        return {
130	            "status": "ok",
131	            "incident": {
132	                "id": incident["id"],
133	                "machine_id": incident["machine_id"],
134	                "event_id": incident["event_id"],
135	                "incident_type": incident["incident_type"],
136	                "summary": incident["summary"],
137	                "status": to_status,
138	                "created_at": incident["created_at"],
139	            },
140	            "history": {
141	                "id": history_id,
142	                "machine_id": machine_id,
143	                "event_id": event_id,
144	                "incident_id": incident_id,
145	                "from_status": from_status,
146	                "to_status": to_status,
147	                "created_at": now,
148	            },
149	        }
150	
151	    return _run_with_lock_retry(engine, _work)
152	
153	
154	def list_status_history(
155	    session: Session, machine_id: str, event_id: str, incident_id: str
156	) -> list[IncidentStatusEvent]:
157	    """Return one incident's immutable transitions in (created_at, id) order."""
158	    return list(
159	        session.scalars(
160	            select(IncidentStatusEvent)
161	            .where(
162	                IncidentStatusEvent.machine_id == machine_id,
163	                IncidentStatusEvent.event_id == event_id,
164	                IncidentStatusEvent.incident_id == incident_id,
165	            )
166	            .order_by(IncidentStatusEvent.created_at, IncidentStatusEvent.id)
167	        )
168	    )
